text: player
The Flower Left in the Corner

Hearing that a new flower market with a wide variety of plants has opened in One Han City, I immediately think of the person who is always tending to flowers and greenery, and head to the gardening club at the National University of Fuuchi.
Gardening Club, National University of Fuuchi
The gardening club is rather quiet this weekend, save for a rhythmic clicking. I follow the sound and spot Hinata Takanashi, totally absorbed in photographing a sunflower.
Hinata Takanashi
Hmm... This angle should capture every single dewdrop on the leaves.
What if I... Oh, the backlight makes it look so adorable!
Hey, Hinata?
Found you!
Whoa?!
Phew... You scared the life out of me! I almost dropped the camera...
{var:player_nickname}, what are you doing here on the weekend?
Were you looking for me? Uh... have I kept you waiting?
Not at all, I just got here.
I knew I'd find you here.
That's a relief. I'd feel terrible if I'd kept you waiting...
Hehe, you know me so well.
So these are the new seedlings you've been telling me about?
Mm-hmm. They always remind me of going to see sunflowers in the countryside with my mom and dad when I was little.
It felt so warm, like the sun was giving me a big hug.
They're so busy lately... so I thought, why not grow my own little slice of sunshine?
I can definitely see them blooming already.
I know, right? They were so frail when I brought them home, but look at them now! They're total naturals in front of the camera.
I'm going to give them some fresh potting mix after this, so I asked Reina for a little time off. I'll be back at Éternité next weekend, I promise!
Well, if you're on a break, you wanna hang out with me today?
I actually came here to invite you to that huge new flower market that just opened.
A flower market? That sounds amazing! I bet there are so many unique plants, but...
Don't worry about the sunflowers. I'll help you take care of them when we get back!
Really? Okay then! Thank you so much, {var:player_nickname}!
Let's get going!
Whoa... this place is even bigger than I imagined!
Flower Market
{var:player_nickname}, look at this Bunny Succulent! It's like tiny bunnies with long ears, isn't it?
It's a bit on the small side, though... looks like it's starving for some fertilizer. I should tell the owner... but first, let me get a photo of it!
You really do enjoy giving plants their own photoshoots, don't you?
Well, they're all so adorable! I feel like every moment of their lives is worth capturing.
And whenever I look back at the pictures, I get to relive all the time I spent with them!
Let's make today a day to remember, then!
Eh? You mean you want to take a photo with me? I'd love to!
If we can, let's include the plants in the photo too. I hope you'll grow fond of them as well.
Let me see what else is on your camera!
What have you been photographing recently?
Oh, I've got some really good ones lately!
Check this out, that's the little bunny succulent from earlier, and here are my sunflower seedlings...
And this one...
Uh...
On the screen is a tiny bonsai tree. Its once-green needles are now covered in dull yellow patches, looking drained of life.
This one is a Buddhist pine. It suffered from major neglect. The roots were waterlogged, which led to a fungal outbreak of anthracnose and leaf blight...
They brought it to me as a last resort... I read every book I could find and tried everything, but I still couldn't...
Hinata...
Anyway, I'm supposed to be having fun with you, {var:player_nickname}! Let's talk about something more cheerful.
Are you sure you're alright?
I'm okay! It's over and done with. Come on, let's see what else they have!
Wow, they have everything! Thanksgiving cacti, baseball plants, even lithops... I've got to take some more shots!
Wait, is that...
Hey, those succulents have those same black spots you showed me earlier...
That's terrible... even in a professional shop like this, they're not being taken care of...
Sigh, how am I ever going to save up enough to buy them all and bring them back home...
Wait, what am I saying? You brought me here to have a good time. Let's go and...
What's the deal here?! I want an explanation right now!!
Sounds like someone's causing a scene.
Let's go check it out!
Customer
I've only had this Haworthia cooperi for a few days, and look at it! Why is it shriveling?
Acting Manager
My apologies, really... The manager is away, and I'm just filling in as the acting manager...
This is the one you bought, right? Let me take a look at it...
Maybe it's just... underwatered? Let's give it some water and see if it helps.
No, don't!
Huh?! Wh-what?! Who are you, miss...?
Look at the soil of this Haworthia cooperi – there's white powder in it. And see how the leaves are yellowing?
It's probably root mealybugs. Watering it now will just make the infestation spread!
Oh, really?! Wait... you're right! The manager told me about this... I almost made a huge mistake!
I've got a lot to learn... If I'd ruined these plants because of my own mistake... I don't even want to think about it.
I really owe you one! Is there anything here that catches your eye? Pick any plant you want, on the house! It's the least I can do.
Oh, it was nothing, really. You don't need to do that...
What about that bunny succulent you were admiring?
Surely you've earned it!
Plus, I'm sure the manager would feel much better knowing the plant is in your hands.
Well, if you insist... thank you! I'll just take this little one, if that's okay...
Really? That little bunny succulent is a bit of a runt... we didn't even think it would sell. Are you sure you don't want something better?
That's okay! I'll take good care of it and make sure it grows big and strong!
Well then, it's all yours. This little one is lucky to have someone like you. Come back anytime!
Shall we see what else the market has to offer?
You bet! There are so many more plants I want to see while we're here!
Alright, let's – wait a second. Is that who I think it is?
Sawako Kitami
Oh! What a pleasant surprise.
Mrs. Kitami! I didn't expect to see you here!
What brings you to the flower market today, Mrs. Kitami?
Well, the basil I was growing at home got some kind of mold... I had to toss it, which is such a shame for my cooking.
So I'm looking for a replacement. This one looks nice and lively. I'm sure the sauce will be wonderful!
You are making sauce with it?
Mm-hmm! You can make a lovely pesto with basil leaves. It goes so well with meat!
I'm still a bit worried, though. If I can't figure out what happened to my last one, I'm afraid I'll lose this one too...
Mold, huh? Yeah, that happens a lot with herbs.
It's probably gray mold or powdery mildew. I wish I could have seen it in person to be sure...
But please, Mrs. Kitami, if you ever have any more plant troubles, you're always welcome to ask me!
Haha, I'll keep that in mind! Thank you.
I kind of thought you'd be a bit sad about plants being used for food, Hinata.
Not at all! My grandma used to say that plants grow up so they can be useful. As long as they're appreciated, they're happy.
It's much better than just being thrown out and forgotten.
Oh, I feel exactly the same way! Respecting your ingredients is the secret to a truly delicious meal.
Oh, I should get some mint too! I've been meaning to make some mint sauce.
Mint sauce? I've always wanted to try that! Mrs. Kitami, would you mind teaching me?
Sure thing! If you'll be my "gardening consultant," I'll be your "cooking consultant." Haha!
What a powerful team...
I'm going to make mint sauce this weekend. You and {var:player_nickname} should definitely come by in the afternoon!
Thank you, Mrs. Kitami!
Thanks, Mrs. Kitami!
Sounds like a plan, then! I'll see you both soon.//nExcuse me, I'd like to pay for these!
And there she goes...
I can't wait to try Mrs. Kitami's food.
Ugh... I had a whole list of things I wanted to ask her about in my head...
Her ability in the kitchen is amazing...
You take really good care of others too, Hinata.
You're just as amazing in your own way, Hinata.
Because even with all these adorable plants around, you didn't get distracted.
You were still thinking about the gardening club and that little bunny succulent. You really care about every single one of them.
Mm-hmm! If I'm going to take them in, I have to be there for them!
I'm here to help if you ever need a hand!
Those plants are so lucky to have you.
Oh! You're so sweet, {var:player_nickname}!
Whether in the cafe or the gardening club, you're always helping me out. I hope I'm not being too much of a burden...
Hey, when you're free, let's go on a picnic sometime. I'll make the sandwiches!
I'm happy to help, but those sandwiches sound like a great bonus!
Awesome, it's settled! Let's get moving. There's still so much of the market left to see!
Th-thank you for the compliment, {var:player_nickname}...
I just want to do my best for them and be there whenever they need me...
Just like how I love spending time with my parents and my grandma.
And honestly... I'm just happy to be by your side right now, {var:player_nickname}.
Whew... there's still so much to see. Let's head that way!
Everything okay? Why'd you stop?
That new little bunny succulent... and those poor plants in the market...
Ugh... It feels like my list of plants to rescue and care for is growing faster than I can keep up with...
I get it. To you, saving a sick plant is more important than just getting a new one.
You got me there, {var:player_nickname}. Was it that obvious?
I've been watching you the whole time.
I know you pretty well by now.
Sorry, I didn't mean to...
Why apologize?
I know we were supposed to be having a great time together, but...
Seeing those sick plants just makes my heart ache. It's like I can't breathe...
I know it's unusual to treat plants like they're my own children... You probably think I'm weird, right?
There's nothing weird about it, Hinata.
D-do you really mean that?
I've seen how hard you study and how much love you put into every single plant.
You're just doing what makes you happy and being kind to living things. That's a wonderful quality, not a weird one.
You really think so, {var:player_nickname}?
Even if I have a dream that might be a little unrealistic...?
Absolutely.
Whatever the dream is, it's okay.
If you really believe in me, {var:player_nickname}, then I think I can find the courage to say it...
There's something I've always wanted to do...
I want to open a shop that's more than just a store. I want it to be a "plant nursery."
I'd take in all the sick and abandoned plants and care for them until they're strong enough to find a new home with someone who truly loves them.
Just like my grandma used to do.
When I was a kid, no one knew how to take care of my grandma's bonsai trees after she was gone. My parents almost got rid of them... it was heartbreaking.
I don't want any other plant to have to go through that.
So I want to build a place like that. A home where every plant, no matter how small, gets a second chance.
I'm working hard to save up for it, but that means I have to be realistic and pass on these sick plants we just saw for now.
But if I just walk away, what's the point of my dream in the first place?
{var:player_nickname}... I feel like I'm failing before I've even started. What should I do?
I've got an idea that might work.
Forget about the money. I'll help you take care of them!
Wait, really?
You've got a lot on your plate, but you don't have to do it alone. I'll be your partner.
{var:player_nickname}...
You're totally right. I was getting so caught up in the "future" that I forgot the "now."
I've got the dream, and I've got your help. Time to stop doubting and start doing!
Let's go, {var:player_nickname}! Let's get those little ones back to the "nursery"!
After you–
It's late already! Those poor plants in the corner need us – run, run, run!
Before I can react, Hinata suddenly grabs my hand and starts running back toward the shop we just left.
You're way stronger than you look! Even if you just tried to walk out with all those plants earlier, no one could've stopped you...
Easy there, Hinata! Save some strength, or we'll be too tired to carry the plants back!
I know! Just a little longer, everyone! I'm coming for you!
Oh, you again? Did you forget something?
Phew... Please... let me... have that one!
Which one are you talking about?
I'll take those ones over there...
And I'm taking these too!
These sick ones? Are you sure? That's like... a dozen pots.
Absolutely! Please, let me give them the care they need!
W-well, I can't say no to that kind of passion. Since you're doing me a favor, I'll give you a discount. It's a pleasure doing business with you!
By the time the last sick plant was settled in the gardening club, it was already pitch black outside.
Phew... That's the last one. Everyone's in a new pot now.
That's a whole lot of plants we just hauled in...
Uh oh.
You're only realizing it now?!
No turning back now, Hinata!
It took four whole hours just to repot, spray, and tag everything...
And that was just the emergency stuff. We still have to check on them every single day...
{var:player_nickname}... what are we going to do? I think we bit off more than we can chew...
Don't worry. We'll do this together.
Looks like we'll need some extra hands...
Sigh... Next time, I won't get so carried away.
{var:player_nickname}... You've got to stop me if I try this again!
Sure, but I'll need to hit the gym first to be strong enough to stop you. But right now...
There's no turning back. Let's make this work, Hinata!
Really?! {var:player_nickname}, do you have a plan? Tell me!
Use that big brain of yours!
We could reach out to everyone in One Han City!
If we start a CatChat account to show everyone how to nurse plants back to health...
It would save so many plants without you having to carry them all back here!
You can't run a nursery alone. You need a whole team of "specialists" and "caretakers" out there!
I get it! You want me to teach others so they can become "specialists" at saving plants, too!
That way... we can save so many more lives than I ever could alone!
Exactly! And to make sure people see it... we might need some "professional" help.
Professional help?
Yeah, someone who's a total "mega influencer" in One Han City.
Hibiki Himekawa
My schedule is packed with fans, you know. Saying yes to you is a huge favor, so don't forget that gift you owe me!
So, is this cute little "noob" the one you were talking about?
Whoa, it's actually her... Hibiki Himekawa! Um, hi... I'm Hinata Takanashi...
Yes. We're starting a CatChat account for plant care, and we need a professional like you to give it a boost.
Seriously? My stream is a sanctuary for hardcore gaming and legit entertainment, and you want me to promote... what, gardening?
I guess that's a no...?
But, {var:player_nickname} showed me your photos. I have to admit, your photography skills and plant knowledge are "hardcore" in their own way...
So, I'll give you guys a shot. We'll do a collab stream: "Emergency Plant Rescue for My Chat"!
But if this is all just a marketing stunt and you mess up, you're gonna get roasted.
No problem!
If it's for the plants... you can count on me!
Viewer A
Help me, Doc! Is this little guy gonna make it? I can't play my games without my plant bro!
Live in Hibiki's Stream
It's leaf scorch. Did you spill soda or something in there? Plants need clean water just like we do!
Viewer B
My orchid just went totally limp. What's wrong with it, Doc?
That's stem rot. You're gonna have to do some surgery and cut away those bad parts. Trust the process. Plants are tougher than they look!
Then grab some fungicide spray from the store. Use just a little bit, nice and even. I'll write the instructions down so you can take a screenshot!
Viewer C
LMAO Hibiki is just standing there like an NPC. The fans are gonna love this!
Viewer D
This plant expert is actually legit. No wonder Hibiki recommended her.
I'm reading the chat, you know! Say another word and you're banned for life!
{var:player_nickname}! We're blowing up! Look at all these new followers!
I didn't realize there were so many plants in One Han City waiting for someone to help them.
People are even coming to adopt the little ones from the club! I'm so glad we did this.
I never could have built this huge team of plant rescuers without you, {var:player_nickname}.
Thank you for giving me the strength to follow my dream!
You're doing great, "Professor" Hinata...!
P-professor...? Oh, I still have a lot to learn!
The bunny succulent – the one that witnessed the birth of the nursery – is sitting in the sun right now. It's still a bit small, but those "bunny ears" look so cute and healthy.
Look, {var:player_nickname}! I think it's finally starting to grow!
Well, it does have the best caretaker in the world looking after it.
Stop, you're making me blush!
Hinata blushes, then seems to remember something. She gently places the little bunny succulent in my palm and picks up her camera.
{var:player_nickname}, let's take a picture for our account's profile photo!
After all, this little one saw everything from the start... and this "nursery" is something we built together.
Sure!
I'd be happy to.
Later, the CatChat named "Sprout Nursery" updated its profile picture: a photo of two hands cupped together, cradling a lovingly tended bunny succulent.
Now, in a sunny corner, that little plant is growing strong, dreaming of the next spring and all the possibilities ahead.
